integrity: Both portable Python implementations and their recorded output are supplied; they use distinct infection-set characterization methods, agree on accepted-seed SHA-256 lists, counts, orbit partitions and graph metrics; independently performed external audit is absent.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite calculations only for dimensions 4 and 5, threshold two, minimum-cardinality seeds and fixed-cardinality one-vertex moves. No claim for other dimensions or nonminimal initial sets. The closeness of unindexed literature and uninspected full text of a 2006 antecedent cannot be settled absolutely.
title: Optimal two-neighbour bootstrap seed reconfiguration in \(Q_4\) and \(Q_5\)
